mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI increases above 2% do not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real Final Sales of Goods decline for 3 months does not precede negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or the correlation coefficient between RSAFS and S&P 500 returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the UNRATE increase does not correlate with immediate negative market reactions.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the INDPRO decrease does not correlate with subsequent negative market performance.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent positive market performance.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals severe labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition of high UNRATE and decreasing PAYEMS does not correlate with negative market performance.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a contracting economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition of high FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with negative market performance.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals supply-side inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition of low INDPRO and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative market performance.
